Evan (product): Heads up  Contour Health wants a tight plan for private deployments: they require customer-managed networking, minimal IP churn on upgrades, and a validated rollback path. They asked for a phased roadmap and acceptance tests by next week.
Ravi (eng-runtime): We can split into two phases. Phase A: BGP peering + DNS handoff + orchestrated canary promotions. Phase B: IP continuity (floating IPs / VIP handoff) and offline installer improvements. Phase A estimate 3w, Phase B 6w.
Maya (field): Contour's NetOps is okay with a short DNS TTL cutover but cannot accept more than 10s of packet loss. They prefer BGP over peering for routing control. Also KMS integration is mandatory.
Diego (solutions): Suggestion: offer a "controlled-swap" flow for Phase A that uses a traffic mirror + gradual shift to limit visible disruption. We'll provide runbook steps and a small test harness.
Ravi (eng-runtime): Implementation note: controlled-swap needs support in the control plane to orchestrate the VIP move and to keep KV cache warm. We'll add a feature flag: "vip_swap_mode": "controlled|immediate".
Evan (product): Proposal: target Phase A as our Q3 measurable: BGP peering, DNS handoff automation, controlled VIP swap, canary promotion API, test checklist, and KMS audit logs. Phase B (IP continuity + airgapped installer) targeted Q4. Agree to align with legal/finance on SLA wording.
Maya (field): Contour will accept Phase A if we deliver: (1) NetOps runbook with verification steps, (2) scripted test harness they can run in their staging, (3) a commit to SLAs for upgrade windows.
Diego (solutions): I'll create the runbook template and the harness. Quick verify commands for canary: ```
# run canary traffic through proxy
curl -H "Host: contour-canary" https://private.example/healthz
# promote
curl -X POST https://console.redwood/api/v1/promote -d '{"tenant":"contour-canary"}'
```
infra-bot: New doc created: /docs/private-deploys/contour-runbook.md. Owner: Diego. Reviewers: Ravi, Maya.
Ravi (eng-runtime): Dependency: installer needs a small extension to accept customer BGP communities and allow static VIP assignment. I'll open an RFC and link here by EOD. If we can't do BGP in time, fallback is managed peering + policy routing.
Evan (product): Action items: Diego to drop runbook + harness by Tue, Ravi to publish RFC and prototype vip_swap_mode by Thu, Maya to confirm Contour's exact SLA thresholds by Wed. We'll present Phase A plan at next steering and mark Phase B as conditional on telemetry from initial customers.
Maya (field): Also capturing cost ask  Contour wants a billing estimate for reserved capacity during upgrade windows. I'll coordinate with finance and add to the runbook.
Evan (product): Thanks team. Consensus leans to Phase A delivery first (Q3) with Phase B deferrable. We'll flag IP-continuity as a hard long-term requirement for regulated customers. :white_check_mark:
